caption:
A swordswoman fights through four elemental realms.
Seedance 2.5 animated every realm in one go.
prompt:
VIDEO PROMPT — 30 seconds. 16:9 landscape. High-end stylized 3D Chinese wuxia animation (cinematic feature-film CG, smooth skin, glossy cloth sim), saturated fantasy color per realm, strong rim light and volumetric glow, heavy speed lines and motion blur, 24mm-35mm wide lenses. Camera: hyper-kinetic tracking, drone sweeps and whip-fast cuts every 0.5-2 seconds. Pacing: nonstop, accelerating montage through four elemental realms — cherry blossom, storm water, fire, ice — and back to cherry blossoms, linked by light-streak and particle transitions.

CHARACTER:
- THE SWORDSWOMAN: young Chinese woman, about 20, fair porcelain skin, large dark eyes, sharp dark brows, small red lips, determined fierce expression. Jet-black hair in a very high, very long ponytail tied with a small silver hair crown, two thin strands framing her face. White cross-collar hanfu robe with teal-green trim on the collar, a dark teal wide sash with white ties, flowing white skirt with teal lining, dark grey forearm bracers. Wields a thin glowing energy sword: a straight blade that burns with golden-white light (reddish-pink glow in the ice realm), leaving bright streaks in the air. Same face, ponytail and robe in every shot.
- ENEMIES: dark armored soldiers with round steel helmets; storm soldiers in conical bamboo hats carrying long spears; mounted cavalry in dark lamellar armor on black warhorses; in the ice realm, hooded white-cloaked figures and ghostly ice archers.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:00.4) — Petal slash. Wide: a pink cherry blossom valley at dusk, purple-violet sky; she sweeps her sword in a wide arc beside a river, a glowing golden streak and a swirl of pink petals spiraling around her.
SHOT 2 (00:00.4-00:01.0) — Ambush. Over-the-shoulder from behind her, then frontal: three helmeted dark-armored soldiers leap at her out of blossom trees; she slashes a blazing horizontal golden streak across all three. Heavy motion blur, flying petals.
SHOT 3 (00:01.0-00:01.9) — Lunge. Low side tracking shot: she lunges right to left, sword fully extended trailing light, white skirt flaring.
SHOT 4 (00:01.9-00:03.2) — River run. High aerial drone shot looking down a winding purple-lit river through the cherry blossom valley; she skims across the water toward camera, glowing sword held out, a wake of spray and petals behind her. Camera glides backward.
SHOT 5 (00:03.2-00:03.6) — Hero pose. Medium close-up, low angle: she grips the glowing sword with both hands, raised diagonally above her right shoulder, fierce eyes, blossom trees behind.
SHOT 6 (00:03.6-00:05.7) — Petal dragon. Wide, camera circling then pulling up and back. MUST SHOW: millions of pink petals form a giant coiling serpent-dragon of translucent pink crystal scales that wraps in a full ring around her, filling the frame, then collapses into a vast spinning pink petal vortex on the water with her tiny at the center (high angle).
SHOT 7 (00:05.7-00:06.2) — Clash. Dark silhouetted soldiers charge at her on the reflective purple water; sword sparks flare.
SHOT 8 (00:06.2-00:06.6) — Embers. Medium-wide: armored soldiers burst apart in orange embers among the blossoms, light glittering on the water.
SHOT 9 (00:06.6-00:06.9) — Transition: a blazing golden light streak whooshes across the frame into darkness.
SHOT 10 (00:06.9-00:08.1) — Storm sea. Wide: dark stormy night, black clouds, choppy dark water; she dashes across the water surface, MUST SHOW: blue-white lightning crackling off her blade; a long line of hat-wearing spear soldiers charging in the background.
SHOT 11 (00:08.1-00:09.5) — Side profile. Close tracking side profile in storm light: her long ponytail streams behind her as she runs facing right; a conical-hat soldier lunges in from the right.
SHOT 12 (00:09.5-00:10.4) — Lightning slide. Low angle: she slides past camera, the glowing blade dragging lightning sparks across the water.
SHOT 13 (00:10.4-00:11.9) — Water dragon. Wide side view: she skims left of frame while the spear army charges from the right. MUST SHOW: a colossal dragon head and neck made of glowing white-blue water surges up out of the sea between them, jaws wide, whiskers and mane of spray, roaring at the soldiers; lightning strikes behind it on the right.
SHOT 14 (00:11.9-00:12.9) — Impact. The water dragon crashes down into a towering wall of white spray and lightning; soldiers are hurled high into the air, silhouetted against the spray.
SHOT 15 (00:12.9-00:13.4) — Transition: a golden light streak rips across a crimson landscape.
SHOT 16 (00:13.4-00:13.9) — Fire field. Wide: crimson sunset battlefield, red grass, flames raging; she slides low across the ground leaving a blinding white-gold energy trail; mounted riders behind.
SHOT 17 (00:13.9-00:14.3) — Low hero. Low-angle medium: she crouches with sword thrust out, fire behind, cavalry on both sides.
SHOT 18 (00:14.3-00:14.8) — Under the horse. Close: a black warhorse charges past the lens; she ducks under it.
SHOT 19 (00:14.8-00:16.6) — Leap. She leaps over the cavalry, slashing at a spear-wielding armored rider on the right; then somersaults high against dark red cloudy sky, robe spinning.
SHOT 20 (00:16.6-00:17.0) — Landing. Medium-wide: she lands on a grassy ridge in a wide stance, sword sweeping out a golden streak; a wall of flame behind her.
SHOT 21 (00:17.0-00:19.4) — Phoenix. Wide from below the hill. A pillar of fire erupts from her position straight into the sky; MUST SHOW: it becomes a gigantic blazing phoenix of gold-orange fire with wings spread across the whole frame, hovering above her on the hilltop, horsemen scattered around her on the slope; the wings sweep down low, then it soars over the riders (shot from behind the cavalry).
SHOT 22 (00:19.4-00:20.0) — Transition: a wall of roaring flame fills the frame.
SHOT 23 (00:20.0-00:20.4) — Maple turn. She spins in a white blur through swirling orange maple leaves.
SHOT 24 (00:20.4-00:21.0) — Ice realm. Medium: snowy rocky shore of a frozen lake, cold blue light; a hooded white-cloaked faceless figure at left; she raises her sword, now glowing reddish-pink.
SHOT 25 (00:21.0-00:21.9) — Charge. Frontal tracking: she charges straight at camera through blowing ice mist, then lunges, glowing blade low, face fierce.
SHOT 26 (00:21.9-00:23.4) — Ice cavern skate. Wide: a colossal frozen cavern with towering ice cliffs and frozen waterfalls; she glides across the glassy frozen lake, sword trailing a pink glow, robe streaming; camera tracks from behind, then the side, then the front.
SHOT 27 (00:23.4-00:24.2) — Wall leap. She leaps high up a frozen waterfall, blade trailing.
SHOT 28 (00:24.2-00:25.0) — Ice surf. She rides a cascading wave of ice and snow down a slope among dark soldiers, then lands on icy rocks.
SHOT 29 (00:25.0-00:27.0) — Crystal lotus. A blinding light bursts from the center of the frozen lake; MUST SHOW: a colossal glowing crystal lotus flower of translucent pale-blue ice unfolds, dominating the center of the frame, a thin vertical beam of light at its base where she kneels tiny; ghostly translucent ice archers drawing bows stand on its outer petals at upper left and right.
SHOT 30 (00:27.0-00:27.4) — Shatter. The lotus explodes into hundreds of ice shards flying outward toward the lens, her small figure standing at the center.
SHOT 31 (00:27.4-00:29.0) — Portal. MUST SHOW: a spinning rainbow vortex portal — green core, pink, orange and white swirling rings — with her floating at its center, sword raised overhead; it opens over a valley of red-blossom trees at golden sunrise, then fades, leaving her floating in the bright sky above the sunlit valley.
SHOT 32 (00:29.0-00:30.1) — Return. Back in the cherry blossom realm, magenta petal carpet: she dashes straight at the lens in a low crouch, sword swept back, then the camera pulls back as she skids to a stop in a low stance, petals exploding around her.

SOUND: no dialogue. Epic Chinese-style orchestral instrumental: pounding taiko drums, soaring erhu and bamboo flute, choir swells, building nonstop. Effects per realm: sword whooshes, petal swirls and wind chimes; thunder cracks, crashing waves and a roaring water dragon; crackling fire, galloping hooves, a phoenix screech; ringing ice, cracking crystal and a glassy shatter; a deep whoosh through the portal and a final drum hit as she lands.
prompt_short: Stylized 3D wuxia animation, 16:9: a white-robed swordswoman with a glowing blade battles through cherry blossoms, a stormy sea with a water dragon, a fire field with a giant phoenix and an ice cavern with a crystal lotus. Epic, nonstop.
